rubric.rule_note: Weights on their own are not a score. Five things are missing before any reproducible total can exist: a scale, a direction, a normalization rule, a rule for missing data, and a policy version. Supplying them here would mean inventing them, and an invented scoring rule misrepresents the rubric it claims to apply.
